name: AI Workstation
description: Combines the S2 hardware resource policy (CPU energy preference biased toward performance, GPU topology reporting, evidence-based memory/storage policy) with the S4 AI-workstation software layer: hardware-backend classification (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/CPU), NVIDIA driver/CUDA-Toolkit/container-toolkit detection, ROCm runtime-evidence-based support checking, PyTorch/Transformers-baseline/inference-runtime (Ollama, llama.cpp) detection, and deterministic AI planning. No driver, CUDA, ROCm, or Python package is installed and no model is downloaded by this repository - see docs/ai/architecture.md and docs/ai/known-limitations.md for what 'implemented' means here.

rollback.notes: No Apply mechanism exists yet in S2/S4; serein hardware plan and serein ai plan are both read-only. See docs/hardware/architecture.md and docs/ai/architecture.md for what a future Apply step would need.
